The '''''Loristar''''' was an [[air-cutter]] operated by the [[Exocron Airfleet]]. Commanded by [[Horzao Darr]], the ''Loristar'' fought through enemy forces to bring relief supplies to surrounded Council forces during Exocron's internal conflicts.
